d81aaaa7ebee.summary: Scientists have found a new way to create a controlled beam of muonium, an exotic atom containing a heavier cousin of the electron. 1bb974bbda70.summary: New supercomputer simulations suggest JWST’s puzzling Little Red Dots are rapidly growing black holes from the early Universe.
